objective: Extend the already SHA-validated 47-position cross-evidence matrix with fixed PRE-ENTRY market-regime measurements visible at the fully closed 4h MR40 signal; no new trading filters or strategy candidate.

feature_contract.signal_index: At fully CLOSED signal 4h candle j, all features may use rows <= j; neither next open nor future price/exit labels affect any predictor.
feature_contract.return_180_closed_bars_pct: 100*(close[j]/close[j-180] - 1), same nonnegative condition used by Momentum30
feature_contract.ATR14_pct: 100*mean over 14 fully closed bars ending at j of max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close))/close[j]; no alternative ATR smoothing
feature_contract.MR40_zscore: Computed from 40 closes strictly BEFORE j with population std, observed close at j

join_contract: Cross-evidence row signal_index j must equal exact original 4h next-open time rows[j+1][0] and each entry UTC. Only 47 unique historical episodes, 25 train and 22 evaluation; trend/ATR generated without passing PnL or winner labels to feature function.
validation: Fail if canonical original SHA, cross report SHA/digest, row count, 4h time, index, labels or windows drift. Separate shadow read-only from Paper. Write report exclusively, no clobber on failure.
output: Per-trade continuous metrics + per-window medians of winners/losers, no optimized cutoffs or p-value fishing. Historical 47 cannot establish OOS, causal loss mechanism, expected future edge or stop fills.
